title: Rabbi Chiyya Ketosfa’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Beitzah 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.38b.3), Rav Safra says, “Have they not heard what Rabbi Chiyya Ketosfa’ah said in the name of Rav?” [Yevamot 104a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.104a.7) mentions Rabbah bar Chiyya Ketosfa’ah.[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1291&lang=en) cites the transmission from Rav and calls Rabbah his son. Hyman’s wording gives the second name as it appears in Yevamot.
